scripts.dev:full: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (-not (Get-Process mysqld -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\xampp\mysql\bin\mysqld.exe' -ArgumentList '--defaults-file=C:\xampp\mysql\bin\my.ini' -WindowStyle Hidden }; Start-Process -FilePath 'php' -ArgumentList 'artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000' -WorkingDirectory 'backend' -WindowStyle Minimized; next dev"
